description: Defines playable story scripts: the asset id to load, the BGM to play, and the map whose level list the script runs in.

ID.simple: Script row id (same as script name in the export).
ID.technical: FName key in ScriptDataTables (DTM +0xA50). UGamePhase_StoryDemoBase looks it up with GetScriptId() and uses the row's Id for the credit/movie widget lists; Story_FindScriptRow uses the same key. The exported rows' ScriptFileName equals ID, but the code treats them as separate fields.

ScriptFileName.simple: Primary asset name of the script cue-sheet data.
ScriptFileName.technical: FName. Story-demo prepare passes it to UGameScriptPlayer::SetScript, which builds FPrimaryAssetId("Script", ScriptFileName). GameScript_IsDlcScript scans every Script row and compares this field to the running script name before checking the StoryDemo progress flag. Retail dereferences the found row unguarded.

Id_Bgm.simple: BGM to play while the script phase runs.
Id_Bgm.technical: FName (row +0x18). Story-demo prepare stops BGM with 0 fade when None, otherwise PlayBgm(Id, 0.0f, 0.5f, true). Retail reads it without a null-row check.

Id_Map.simple: Map row whose level names become the script's levels.
Id_Map.technical: FName (row +0x20). Story_GetScriptLevels_1307AE0 looks up this Script row, then resolves the Map row with a None check and returns Map.FileName; no level list is returned when either row is missing. Callers include battle-story, credits, collection, main-menu story and story character-select phase transitions.

notes: Constructor leaves all fields at FName() defaults (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_Script.cpp:3).

Only a minority of exported rows set Id_Map; scripts without one get an empty level list from Story_GetScriptLevels_1307AE0 rather than a random map (random-map fallback exists only for StoryMission.Id_Map).
No numbered shards or localization variants were found in the exported set. Consumer source is reconstructed; no claim of exhaustive Blueprint usage is made.

usages.detail: Prepare state 0 reads Id_Bgm, ScriptFileName and Id (credit/movie script lists).
Turns ScriptFileName into the PrimaryAssetId used by the script loader.
Resolves Id_Map into the Map row's FileName list.
DLC-script test: ScriptFileName match followed by StoryDemo pre/post script and chapter progress-flag check.
